mapper.select: select connection_id, from "user_friend_connection" where (first_connection_id=#{firstUserId} or second_user_id=#{firstUserId}) and (first_connection_id=#{secondUserId} or second_user_id=#{secondUserId})
mapper.update: update "user_friend_connection" set applicant_user_id=#{applicantUserId},respondent_user_id=#{respondentUserId},is_delete=false,is_accept=null where connection_id=#{connectionId} and applicant_user_id is null and respondent_user_id is null and is_delete=true
mapper.select: select connection_id, first_user_id, second_user_id, applicant_user_id, create_time, is_accept, is_delete from "user_friend_connection" where respondent_user_id=#{userId} and is_accept is null and is_delete=false limit #{need},offset #{start}

select connection_id, applicant_user_id, respondent_user_id, create_time, is_accept, is_delete from "user_friend_connection" where applicant_user_id=#{userId} and is_accept is null and is_delete=false limit #{need},offset #{start}

select connection_id, applicant_user_id, respondent_user_id, create_time, is_accept, is_delete from "user_friend_connection" where (applicant_user_id=#{userId} or respondent_user_id=#{userId}) and is_accept=true and is_delete=false limit #{need},offset #{start}

update "user_friend_connection" set is_accept=#{value} ,is_delete=true where connection_id=#{connectionId} and respondent_user_id=#{respondentUserId} and is_delete=false and is_accept is null returning version

update "user_friend_connection" set is_delete=true,version=version+1 where connection_id=#{connectionId} and (first_user_id=#{userId} or second_user_id=#{userId}) and is_delete=false and is_accept=true returning version
